source("feature_engineering_functions.R")
training_data <- readRDS("training_data.rds")

poisson_formula <- Goals ~ DSTF + TeamRankCategory + HomeAway + DLF + OpponentRankCategory + 
    DCS + DYF + DSF + goals_scored_per_match

beta_grid <- seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.01)


draw_rate <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(match_id, HomeAway, Goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = HomeAway, values_from = Goals) %>%
    summarise(D = mean(Home == Away)) %>%
    pull(D)
}

# Build a function which converts predicted goals into match outcomes and then calculates the predicted and actual league tables
season_table <- function(df, beta) {
  mp <- df %>%
    select(match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = HomeAway,
                values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)) %>%
    mutate(
      gd       = predicted_goals_Home - predicted_goals_Away,
      pred_res = case_when(abs(gd) <= beta ~ "D", gd > beta ~ "H", TRUE ~ "A"),
      act_res  = case_when(Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
                           Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A", TRUE ~ "D")
    )

  pts <- function(res, side) case_when(res == side ~ 3, res == "D" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)

  tab <- bind_rows(
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Home,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "H"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "H"),
                     pred_gd = gd, act_gd = Goals_Home - Goals_Away,
                     act_gf = Goals_Home),
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Away,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "A"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "A"),
                     pred_gd = -gd, act_gd = Goals_Away - Goals_Home,
                     act_gf = Goals_Away)
  ) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(pred_pts), desc(pred_gd), Team) %>%        
    mutate(pred_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(desc(act_pts), desc(act_gd), desc(act_gf), Team) %>%  
    mutate(act_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(Team)

  list(tab = tab, mp = mp)
}

beta_cv <- function(training_data, poisson_formula, beta_grid, min_train = 5) {

  seasons <- training_data %>%
    distinct(Year) %>%
    mutate(s = as.integer(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
    arrange(s) %>% pull(Year)

  map_dfr((min_train + 1):length(seasons), function(i) {

    train_fold <- training_data %>% filter(Year %in% seasons[1:(i - 1)])
    valid_fold <- training_data %>% filter(Year == seasons[i])

    # Target: average draw share of the earlier seasons
    target_draw <- mean(map_dbl(seasons[1:(i - 1)], function(s) {
      draw_rate(train_fold %>% filter(Year == s))
    }))

    m <- glm(poisson_formula, data = train_fold,
             family = stats::poisson(link = "log"))

    valid_fold <- valid_fold %>%
      mutate(predicted_goals = predict(m, newdata = valid_fold, type = "response"))

    map_dfr(beta_grid, function(b) {
      st <- season_table(valid_fold, b)
      tibble(
        Season      = seasons[i],
        Beta        = b,
        target_draw = target_draw,
        act_draw    = mean(st$mp$act_res == "D"),
        pred_draw   = mean(st$mp$pred_res == "D"),
        pred_home   = mean(st$mp$pred_res == "H"),
        pred_away   = mean(st$mp$pred_res == "A"),
        accuracy    = mean(st$mp$pred_res == st$mp$act_res),
        rank_mse    = mean((st$tab$pred_rank - st$tab$act_rank)^2),
        spearman    = cor(st$tab$pred_rank, st$tab$act_rank, method = "spearman")
      )
    })
  })
}

beta_results <- beta_cv(training_data, poisson_formula, beta_grid)


beta_chosen_by_season <- beta_results %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  slice_min(abs(pred_draw - target_draw), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

beta_chosen_by_season %>%
  select(Season, Beta, target_draw, pred_draw, act_draw,
         pred_home, pred_away, accuracy, rank_mse, spearman)
## # A tibble: 6 × 10
##   Season   Beta target_draw pred_draw act_draw pred_home pred_away accuracy
##   <chr>   <dbl>       <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1 2019/20  0.25       0.239     0.239    0.242     0.537     0.224    0.495
## 2 2020/21  0.25       0.239     0.242    0.218     0.542     0.216    0.471
## 3 2021/22  0.24       0.236     0.239    0.232     0.5       0.261    0.511
## 4 2022/23  0.27       0.236     0.237    0.229     0.484     0.279    0.466
## 5 2023/24  0.29       0.235     0.226    0.216     0.495     0.279    0.537
## 6 2024/25  0.28       0.233     0.229    0.245     0.511     0.261    0.476
## # ℹ 2 more variables: rank_mse <dbl>, spearman <dbl>
# Summary across validation seasons
beta_chosen_by_season %>%
  summarise(mean_beta = mean(Beta), sd_beta = sd(Beta),
            min_beta = min(Beta), max_beta = max(Beta))
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##   mean_beta sd_beta min_beta max_beta
##       <dbl>   <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1     0.263  0.0197     0.24     0.29
ggplot(beta_results, aes(Beta, pred_draw, colour = Season)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_line(aes(y = target_draw), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = beta_chosen_by_season, size = 2) +
  labs(y = "Predicted draw share")

beta_results %>%
  group_by(Beta) %>%
  summarise(mean_rank_mse = mean(rank_mse), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(Beta, mean_rank_mse)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(beta_chosen_by_season$Beta), colour = "red") +
  labs(y = "Mean squared rank error")

For the test, I will use beta = 0.263.
